Electrically, yes — India runs 230V like Europe, so an EU-plug unit plus a type C/F to type D adapter is fine. A US-plug one isn't: that's 120V and would need a transformer, not an adapter.

The catch is checkout itself locks the EU variant to Europe/UK/AU/NZ and a few others. That's the part Georges has to clear.
So better u talk to George and explain the situation and get back to me

Already done — he has the full picture: India, PIN (postcode ····), the DC06 bundle, every address rejected, and that you're fine with an EU plug plus an adapter.

You're right to be annoyed — that's two days of "wait" and no answer. I've put both on the same flag so it's one reply covering the weight, the India quote and the plug lock, not another round trip.

Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s, ships November 30, 2026 — 5.9 kg, also $40.

Both run 100–240V, so no transformer. Duty and IGST are still on delivery.
